records.second_pass_reason: Frozen row capitalone__datacompy-404 contains 3 FAIL_TO_PASS selectors: numpy arrays, Python lists, and Polars lists. Issue #58 concerns only equal empty NumPy arrays. The broad NumPy selector test_columns_equal_numpy_arrays first asserts equality for non-empty np.array([j]) cells; the exact base columns_equal() short-circuits mixed object series to all False before reaching the empty-array block at the end. The two other frozen selectors test list/Polars-list support and are unrelated to issue #58's narrow defect. Do not drop selectors, reorder tests, or substitute a handcrafted selector; immutable row cannot presently satisfy issue-specific oracle gate.
